problems: The silhouette reads as a generic stick figure or branching sprig rather than kelp. The vertical spine (holdfast 272,440 to heart 282,294 to crown float 373,139) with side branches looks like a person's body with a head circle, arms and legs, so the blind guess is only partly right. The kelp character (wavy, broad, ribbon-like fronds) is missing.

Stars sit on roughly the right parts: holdfast at the bottom, stalk running up to the crown float and crown frond at the top, heart at the centre junction, and tips at the left and right ends. The figure is upright, with the holdfast at the bottom and the crown at the top.
The blue outline is a real silhouette offset from the gold lines, so it is not just a copy of the gold skeleton. However, the outline is thin and close to the gold lines, so the body mass is weak.

Labels collide: 'heart' overlaps the stalk and body lines, 'holdfast' sits on the outline, and 'base frond' and 'base frond tip' overlap each other. 'upper left frond' and 'small left tip' also crowd the same area.
The crown float circle is a small hollow ring, so it does not read as a bride's veil or crown and works poorly as a head.
